root_cause: The bug is due to incorrect handling of multiple consecutive '|' characters and cases where the '|' characters are at the start or end of the string, leading to faulty segment replacement.
suggestion: Suggestion 1. Correct handling of multiple '|' characters Ensure that when searching for the second '|' character, the `rfind` method is used instead of `find` to locate the last occurrence of '|' instead of the next one. This helps to correctly handle cases where '|' might appear multiple times in the string.
fix_code:
string = input()
start = string.find("|", 0)
end = string.rfind("|") + 1  # Use rfind to locate the last occurrence of '|'
if not(start == (end - 2)): 
    string = string.replace(string[start:end], "")  # Properly handle the segment removal
else: 
    string = string.replace("|", "")
